body: REVIEW BLOCK on unregistered Stage 1b successor fce00c843fca2141e7a0b877d2b46afa18b0ca70. Exact two-file diff and production comparison are correct: it checks attempt.receipt.requestChecksum against input.checksum after id/order, with expected=input and found=attempt receipt. But the acceptance contract also requires the typed mismatch to report its index, and the sole foreign-input court exercises only index 0. Independent isolated mutation at /private/tmp/storymodel4s-stage1b-review.HVFWhI/repo replaced the returned index variable with literal 0; ConformingSuite still passed 34/34. Compilation emitted only an unused-pattern-variable warning, so the tests do not enforce the published index. Required amendment: make the same-id foreign exact input the second element of a lawful two-item batch and assert index 1, while preserving the existing id/order precedence and checksum fields. No candidate exists, so no candidate register was changed.
